answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making identity a slow-thaw collateral lock. Each new persona must park stake that sits like a glacier: it cannot be withdrawn until a long, observed service window ends. Reputation is a single sable thread tying one operator to one bond; spinning clones snaps that thread because each extra identity needs its own full lock. An attacker paying for N fakes therefore burns N times the deposit and N times the wait, while fake votes stay frozen until the ice actually melts.
